highlights: Fixed: Ryli’s voice and your sound effects could go silent until you refreshed the overlay in OBS. RYLI now repairs its own audio whenever it reconnects, so restarting RYLI with OBS left open just works.

Fixed: you can finally hear sound in the browser window RYLI opens. It was being launched muted by mistake, which is why shows you were watching — and anything else in that window — were silent. Your own show still starts muted, the way Whatnot does it, so nothing echoes back to your viewers.
Auto-start auctions is a little more robust: the piece that captures your auction settings now re-arms on the same schedule as everything else.
The ticker rail is bigger and easier to read at a glance, and the little diamond between messages now sits properly centred instead of riding high.
You can now read every release RYLI has ever shipped: there is a “What’s new” link beside the version in Settings → About, and a “See all changes” link in this popup.
Your camera in the jumbotron is now FREE for everyone. It used to be a Pro feature — it isn't any more, on any plan. Turn it on in Settings → Appearance & FX.
Fixed the ad-banner size guidance. The slot is 2.94:1, so 1468 x 500 px fills it edge to edge — the old advice (1000 x 360) always left a small gap down each side.
The built-in RYLI Pro banner has been replaced with one that actually fits the slot properly.

New: Ryli Companion — a small control panel Ryli paints right into your Whatnot window. See at a glance what's running and flip things on or off without looking away from your show. Drag it anywhere, or shrink it to the orb. Only you can see it; viewers never do.
New: auto-start auctions (Pro). Ryli re-runs your listing after each sale so you're not clicking between every lot. She stops herself and says so out loud if a lot gets no bids.
Ryli can now tell you out loud when auto-auctions or auto-giveaways turn on or off, so you never have to check the app mid-show.
Offer alerts no longer read the dollar amount out loud — you get told an offer came in and on what, and the figure stays on your screen.
Fixed: on Windows, Ctrl+Alt is AltGr and such hotkeys silently never fire even though they save. Settings now warns you and suggests a function key instead.
Fixed: the overlay and Moment Zone now ship pre-positioned and locked, so they land in the right spot on a fresh install.

Plus a batch of fixes from a full pre-release audit — including mute buttons that needed two presses, notes showing the oldest entries instead of the newest, and several hotkeys that could not be cleared.
New Stream Store item: BRB Retro Screensaver — a transparent, bouncing "Be Right Back" sign for stepping away without ending your show.
The "New" badge on the Stream Store is now a gold pill that actually says how many items are waiting, instead of a plain dot.
The Stream Store's "All" view now mixes overlays and Stream Deck icons together, so you can see everything on offer at a glance instead of one type at a time.
New items in the Stream Store now show a badge on your dashboard and in Settings, so you'll know when something's been added without having to go look.
An update banner now appears on your dashboard when a new version of RYLI is ready. You can dismiss it — it stays available in Settings → About until you update.
Settings → About now tells you when an update is still downloading, instead of showing nothing until it finished.
Giveaway auto-restart now works. RYLI opens the next round on her own after a winner is drawn — confirmed live on a real show.

New: offer alerts. Ryli can tell you out loud when a viewer makes an offer on a shop listing, so you notice it mid-auction instead of finding it later. Off by default — turn it on in Settings → Configure Ryli.

Big speed improvement on busy shows: fixed a slowdown that got worse the more chat and reactions came in — exactly during bid wars and emote storms. Message handling is now about 11x faster and uses a third of the memory.
Auto Chat is more reliable — it now finds your live show correctly even with several Whatnot tabs open.
Verified compatible with OBS Studio 32.2.
Insights page: one clean sales chart that now shows whether you're trending up or down, in both the all-time and date-filtered views.
Settings toggles got a real on/off switch look, and dropdown menus now highlight in RYLI blue instead of an odd orange.
Fixed a rare license-check timing issue that could momentarily show Pro as off right after switching license keys.
Fixed a case where a voice note taken right as you closed RYLI could be lost.
Various under-the-hood reliability fixes.

New: Auto Chat (Pro) — have Ryli post a reminder message to your live chat on a hotkey press, an automatic timer (5–60 min presets), or both. Optionally have her say it out loud too. Find it in Settings → Configure Ryli → Talk and listen.

Fixed: Ryli's voice could occasionally overlap with another announcement playing at the same time — she now always waits her turn, and other announcements now correctly wait for her to finish instead of talking over her.
Fixed: pressing Ryli's hotkey right after an announcement could look like it did nothing — it now always works.
Various under-the-hood reliability fixes for hotkeys, timers, and overlay performance.

Fixed an important bug: if you left RYLI running and went live again without restarting the app, tracking could get stuck paused for the entire next show — no bids, chat, wins, or voice reacting at all. RYLI now always re-confirms your show correctly, even across multiple streams without a restart.
RYLI now lets you know it's still running in the tray after you close the window, with a "don't show this again" option.
Fixed: "Go Live" could silently fail to open Chrome on some Windows setups — it now finds Chrome more reliably and tells you clearly if it can't, instead of doing nothing.
New: Ticker Rail (Pro) — an optional scrolling stat/text band attached to the top or bottom of your overlay.
Clearer upgrade paths throughout the app — locked Pro features now show a real "Upgrade to Pro" link instead of just not working.
Various data-accuracy, stability, and performance fixes under the hood.
New: ThermalFlow (Pro) — print a label to a USB label printer the instant a lot sells.
The free trial is now 10 days.
RYLI now lives in your system tray — closing the window hides it instead of quitting, so an accidental click can't drop your overlay/OBS connection mid-show.
Fixed: a real tip now shows and announces as a tip instead of a generic shop purchase.
Various print-quality, performance, and stability fixes.
